correctness.rationale: For independent equal strata with predeclared arbitrary centered L² controls, monotone functions are positive mixtures of unit steps, and convexity of error squared reduces sup variance to one jump. At jump local position t in stratum j, n² risk=∑||g_i||²+t(1−t)−2⟨h_t,g_j⟩. Averaging j uniformly and t in [1/2−1/(2n),1/2+1/(2n)] yields a unique squared-norm completion at g_i=m/n, where m is the centered clipped ramp. Its max step risk is flat exactly on that central interval, so the lower minimax bound is attained. Formula (3n²−3n+1)/(12n⁴), including n=2 value 7/192; uniqueness follows strict square penalty. Independently exact-rational checks at n=1,2,3,4,5,8 verify the finite formulas, but the Hilbert argument proves all controls and monotone f.
